Class AesEncryptionHelper

Namespace
NuvTools.Security.Helpers
Assembly
NuvTools.Security.dll

Provides helper methods for AES symmetric encryption and decryption. The encryption format is AES-CBC with the layout IV (16 bytes) + ciphertext, using a SHA-256-derived key.
